runtimeInterface.initialization: compileCatalog(data) synchronously validates, compiles and sets the active module catalogue; loadCatalog(url) is the local-fetch convenience.
runtimeInterface.getApplicable: getApplicable(state,{stage:LAST_LAYER|PLL|F2L|COLL,catalog?,profile?,preferColl?,allowEollPrep?}) returns every verified applicable candidate; no top-N limit.
runtimeInterface.bestContinuation: Pruned exact best first segment plus actual PLL/AUF continuation in the same finite catalogue; full-state/profile/EOLL-aware caches.
runtimeInterface.executionScore: Comparative weighted execution score only, never measured or estimated seconds. Actual resulting permutation determines the PLL/EPLL continuation.
runtimeInterface.metrics: HTM: outer/wide turn=1, slice=2; QTM counts half turns twice; whole-cube rotations counted separately.
runtimeInterface.eoll: Optional finite library of three imported standard short EOLL formulas; one/two-step preparation; all resulting candidates retained. EOLL followed by already oriented corners can continue directly to PLL and is labelled EOLL → PLL.
runtimeInterface.deduplication: Only identical canonical move sequences are grouped, with all source records retained. OLL masks or orientation-only results never merge distinct full effects.
